pages.text: The King is dead. The Tribe now has to decide what that makes you.$(br2)His crown changes how lesser ogres regard its wearer, though elite challengers may dispute the claim. His club carries the weight of a royal ground slam.

pages.title: Ogre King's Crown
pages.text: Wear the claim. Expect the Tribe to notice.

pages.title: Ogre King's Club
pages.text: A royal weapon whose active slam and exact combat attributes are shown in its tooltip.
